decisions.rationale: Five contemporary daily-life rigs, 44 joints, 7730–11243 triangles, 6–8 material primitives, 1024px main atlas. Walk/talk/listen/sit clips present. Names/costumes do not rewrite actor identity.
gates: Compare ZIP2/3/4 before choosing the common final character style
Explicit Adult_/Plus-size clip mapping and joint aliases; root-motion removal including hips, clone/source immutability
Uniform proportions, full gait/cycle/activity envelope inside existing navigation radius; sole contact, surface labels and prop contact
Merge only compatible atlas/material groups; correct multi-material UVs, skin indices and bind matrices; no last-texture-wins flattening
Bound 3core + 5near rigs; geometry LOD and shared texture cache, preserve current draw-call/triangle budgets
City and all four Studio scenes desktop/mobile real screenshots, audio/seek/pause/dispose and failure/late-load checks

decisions.rationale: Theatrical costumes; suitable for explicitly scripted stage/festival scenes after shared style review, not the default daily crowd.

Select ordinary chairs, desk, monitor, book, lamp, planter, chess board/pieces for home/work/shop/park phases; exclude casino-only machines/cards from daily city needs. Deduplicate atlas and repeated furniture; inventory/ownership/physical usage needs separate authority.

225 modular static models, 12–16969 triangles, one material/32px palette each. Select trees, fruit, bowls, bench, fence and simple rural props for flora/home/market. Exclude medieval architectural modules from modern city until an explicit setting exists.

Eight stalls and full layout. Actual full GLB is115240 triangles/384 primitives/26 materials, not README54952. Select ordinary carts/baskets/food only; atlas/merge/LOD and collider placement first. Do not duplicate GLB with FBX/OBJ/source exports.

The same GLB SHA repeats. Keep one canonical only if indoor need exists; 57064 triangles includes240 UCX collision objects. Separate render mesh and navigation collision, inspect normals/interiors. Listing is not license evidence or a command to publish.

Container17440 triangles/3×4K maps and bench944 triangles/3×2K maps are excessive for repeated city props. Prefer current instanced props; consider optimized atlas/LOD only for future dock/interior setting.

Tripo-created static chibi meshes, about5k triangles/4K texture; no skin or animation. Biblical costume and proportions differ; cannot serve animated citizens without a new rig/retarget and style pass.
Five .blend and five .mov files; no runtime skeletal clips in GLB. Requires offline DCC export/retarget if future chosen character matches. Do not execute .blend scripts or ship625MB sources/videos.
75 independent1024px base-color textures, no matching rig identified. Same filenames do not prove matching UVs; no current palette-swapping import.

Actual previews are backpack32688 triangles/39.2MB and chair20876 triangles/20MB, each3×4K maps. Better existing low-cost equivalents; names require semantic rename if a future optimized derivative is used.

1.28M-triangle scene, monolithic82MB city,444.8MB crate with3×8192px maps (~768MiB RGBA before mipmaps), and three static1.5M-triangle fantasy/scifi characters respectively. Poor fit for current setting/budgets; retain review hashes, not binaries in repo/runtime.

Normalize per-module units/origin/bounds, assemble doors/entrances and occupancy/colliders explicitly
Remove repeated maps/metadata, atlas compatible materials and bake/reencode normal/ORM in correct color space; certify visual quality
Generate geometry/material LOD/culling per module, demand-load only; no612MB monolithic preload

decisions.reason: 75736 canonical triangles,30primitives/167joints/13clips. Browser draws101410 triangles/34calls because nodes can reuse meshes. Mechanical assembly/translation clips need mapping to actual ground distance, not wall time or cosmetic travel. Existing bicycle is cheaper and tested.
decisions.provenance: Embedded author UDD-CID, source Sketchfab, notice COPYRIGHT TO UDD-CID. Keep that exact notice/source and owner-confirmed-free record; never label CC0.

decisions.reason: UE mannequin with four LODs all present,58905 total triangles/8skins, one Unreal Take7.2s. Choose one LOD and explicit rig/clip semantics before retarget; not an extra daily civilian. No facial/personality/learning inference from its mesh.

25 music tracks named Enchanted Forest Music,48kHz stereo PCM,89.655min total. This is authored music, not footsteps/real street ambience/speech. Mean volume is dBFS from volumedetect, not LUFS; many rounded peaks near0dBFS do not alone prove clipping.
gates: Human listening/style check before choosing1–3tracks; existing Vietnamese voices stay intact
Convert selected tracks to OGG/Opus or Vorbis, measure true/integrated loudness and peak headroom; verify loop/crossfade
Reuse one opt-in audio lifecycle, duck music during dialogue, mute/pause/seek/hidden/unmount and no autoplay
Keep original25WAVs only in source vault; no complete WAV preload or blanket runtime import

requirementsBeforeRuntime: Choose one canonical LOD, not all five copies of the same textures
